title: Bitter gourd: modeled ₹966/qtl left, Kondotty → Kayamkulam
summary: January 2021: reported bitter gourd prices at Kondotty and Kayamkulam imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹966 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 516 same-variety market pairs screened for bitter gourd in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kayamkulam report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Kondotty (Kerala) and Kayamkulam (Kerala) both reported bitter gourd prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kondotty reported a median ₹3,500 per quintal. Kayamkulam reported a median ₹4,900 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,500/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,500 per quintal, and Kayamkulam was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 267 km by road
scenes.caption: 267 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹58/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹999 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹733 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kayamkulam report, the rule selects 24 of 24 modeled shipping days. 24 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹966 per quintal (₹704 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Bitter gourd route from Kondotty to Kayamkulam was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹96,600, or ₹70,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to bitter gourd
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹58/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Bitter gourd route from Kondotty to Kayamkulam was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹96,600, or ₹70,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
